explanation: Generating text is easiest when you build a list of lines and join it at the end, instead of appending newlines as you go and then fighting a trailing one. Collecting the tag lines separately answers the "is there at least one tag?" question that decides whether the blank star line appears. Prefixing every line with the indent at join time keeps the indentation rule in exactly one place.
hints: Collect the tag lines (@param and maybe @return) in their own list first -- whether that list is empty decides if the " *" separator line appears.
The method name is the last word before '(' and the return type is the word before that.
Build a List<String> of unindented lines, then join them with "\n", writing the indent in front of each one.
